name: CIW Carribean Heavyweight Title
epitaph: Billed as the promotion's own top prize, to be defended every thirty days; no champion is recorded in the surviving document.

name: CIW Island Paradise Title
epitaph: Billed as the promotion's own secondary title and usual number-one contendership for the heavyweight title; no champion is recorded in the surviving document.

name: CIW Carribean Tag Team Titles
epitaph: Billed as the promotion's own tag titles; no champions are recorded in the surviving document.
